what: External trust root for the frozen metric. Pins every artifact whose bytes define the outcome gate: the blind problems, the scored concept/alias map + recall denominator (gmetric_v1.json), and the three loaded corpus snapshots. The grader verifies the on-disk substrate against THESE pins, never against a pin stored inside gmetric_v1.json (which it grades against -- that would be circular, CWE-345). Regenerating this manifest is the only way to move a pin, and it is a visible, reviewable change in version control.
